name: translation-key-helper
description: Generate Kuril i18n keys and concise English and Thai translations from Chinese copy, screenshots, or UI context.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Kuril translation keys and translations.
interface.longDescription: Infer UI type and product module, generate concise keys, translate to English and Thai, preserve {n}, and flag likely duplicates.
defaultPrompt: Generate a key and English and Thai translations for this Chinese copy.
Classify this copy as a button, title, Toast, Tips, Tag, Placeholder, or Empty state.
